name: Cypress Mandela Apply / Orientation
what_it_contains: Orientation date; cohort date; eligibility documents; schedule; contact
recommended_ingestion: weekly HTML extraction plus manual check 7 days before event
robots_or_terms_note: Respect robots and site terms; cache page hash
pii_risk: low on page; high if following applicant forms
notes: Do not ingest applicant responses.

name: West Oakland Job Resource Center
what_it_contains: Services; employer referrals; local-hire support; contact
recommended_ingestion: monthly organization refresh
notes: Use separate source for interest form.

name: WOJRC Job-Seeker Interest Form
what_it_contains: Applicant intake entry point
recommended_ingestion: store only the URL and program metadata; never scrape submissions
robots_or_terms_note: No automated submission; no collection without consent
notes: Explicit privacy boundary.

name: CityBuild Academy Application Page
what_it_contains: Eligibility; 12-week format; application workflow; contact
recommended_ingestion: weekly during recruitment seasons; monthly otherwise
pii_risk: low on page; high after form handoff
notes: Interest form does not guarantee selection.

name: CityBuild Employment Network Services
what_it_contains: Worker eligibility; referral process; contact
recommended_ingestion: monthly
pii_risk: low on page; high in worker database
notes: Direct job-referral route for current union workers.

name: Mission Hiring Hall CityBuild Academy
what_it_contains: CityBuild partner intake and program description
recommended_ingestion: monthly
notes: Cross-check dates with SF.gov.

name: Rising Sun Opportunity Build
what_it_contains: Cohorts; info sessions; eligibility; certifications; stipend; contact
recommended_ingestion: weekly while applications active
notes: High-value structured intake source.

name: Tradeswomen Upcoming Events
what_it_contains: Job fairs; apprenticeship dates; test prep; workforce events
recommended_ingestion: daily; filter geography; verify referenced dates and registration status
notes: Event copy can carry stale cohort language; keep verification flags.

name: Tradeswomen Job Postings
what_it_contains: Trades job leads and application links
recommended_ingestion: daily; parse deadline; confirm employer page before marking active
robots_or_terms_note: Respect site terms; do not assume listing removal on expiry
notes: Two recent SF posts were already expired, proving the need for deadline logic.

name: CTWI Union Construction Careers
what_it_contains: Union/JATC application status and windows by trade
recommended_ingestion: daily or weekly; contact JATC for confirmation
notes: Consolidates many unions; some entries retain older dates.

name: CTWI How to Get Started
what_it_contains: Trade taxonomy; MC3/pre-apprenticeship partners; apprenticeship basics
recommended_ingestion: quarterly taxonomy refresh
notes: Useful for categories and partner discovery, not live openings.

name: CTWI Employers / MAPLA
what_it_contains: Employer services; MAPLA relationships; contractor and union connections
recommended_ingestion: quarterly and event-driven
notes: Good source for organization graph expansion.

name: California DIR Apprenticeship Program Search
what_it_contains: Registered programs by county, trade and occupation
recommended_ingestion: monthly county snapshots; preserve registry date
notes: DIR explicitly warns that registration does not mean applications are open.

name: Building California Apprenticeship Program Directory
what_it_contains: Program names, addresses, phones, emails and trade categories
recommended_ingestion: monthly; deduplicate against DIR
notes: Strong contact enrichment; does not indicate open applications.

name: SF Building Trades Affiliates
what_it_contains: Affiliated unions, addresses, phones and websites
recommended_ingestion: monthly
notes: Use to discover union nodes, then verify apprenticeship details elsewhere.

name: Port of Oakland Workforce Development
what_it_contains: MAPLA geography; workforce goals; outcomes; partner ecosystem
recommended_ingestion: quarterly plus project-event updates
notes: Local-hire demand signal and partner graph.

name: Port of Oakland MAPLA Notice
what_it_contains: Covered-work rules and union hiring-hall routing
recommended_ingestion: annual or when document changes
notes: Explains why union hiring halls are critical supply routes.

name: SF Public Works Bid Opportunities
what_it_contains: Active construction bids, scopes, estimates, deadlines, LBE and local-hire terms
recommended_ingestion: daily; classify trade demand from scope with inference flag
notes: Creative upstream hiring signal; never label a bid as an individual job.

name: City and County of San Francisco Careers
what_it_contains: Official city job postings and application links
recommended_ingestion: daily; use official posting as canonical
robots_or_terms_note: Official job board; respect SmartRecruiters terms
pii_risk: low on listing; high in applications
notes: Canonical status source for SF roles.

name: SF Citywide Exam Opportunities
what_it_contains: Continuous and class-based eligibility-list opportunities
recommended_ingestion: daily; follow each detail page for deadlines
notes: Especially useful because one application can feed multiple later vacancies.

name: EBMUD Job Opportunities
what_it_contains: Utility operations, maintenance, engineering and trades openings
recommended_ingestion: daily link/feed check; official page canonical
robots_or_terms_note: Respect GovernmentJobs terms and rate limits
pii_risk: low on listing; high in applications
notes: Pair with EBMUD outreach events.

name: BayworkJobs
what_it_contains: Water and wastewater job postings from regional agencies
recommended_ingestion: daily; confirm on employer site
notes: Niche and useful, but open-ended deadlines require revalidation.

name: Alameda County WDB Job Seeker Resources
what_it_contains: Training, OJT and AJCC resources
recommended_ingestion: monthly
notes: Broad workforce source; add trade-specific tags only with evidence.

name: EastBayWorks
what_it_contains: Career centers, workshops and recruitment events
recommended_ingestion: weekly events; quarterly locations
notes: Useful for supportive services and job fairs.

name: Oakland Local Resident Construction Hiring
what_it_contains: Resident construction worker registration and contractor local-hire requests
recommended_ingestion: monthly page check; link users to official intake
robots_or_terms_note: Official City page; availability may vary
notes: Page was intermittently unavailable; do not mirror PII.

name: APRI SF Workforce Development
what_it_contains: CityBuild recruiting and contact
recommended_ingestion: monthly; phone verification for sessions
notes: Community-based referral channel.

name: Young Community Developers Services
what_it_contains: Job readiness, CityBuild-related recruitment and placement services
recommended_ingestion: monthly
notes: Confirm exact intake windows directly.

name: BART Careers
what_it_contains: Transit operations, facilities, track, electrical and maintenance roles
recommended_ingestion: daily
robots_or_terms_note: Respect GovernmentJobs terms and rate limits
pii_risk: low on listing; high in applications
notes: Use job-description taxonomy only to classify live official postings.

name: CalJOBS
what_it_contains: Employer job listings and workforce services
recommended_ingestion: link/search integration first; avoid scraping authenticated results
robots_or_terms_note: Follow portal terms; prefer official integrations
notes: Broad backup source; geography and trade taxonomy needed.

name: CalCareers Geographic Search
what_it_contains: State jobs filtered by county/geography
recommended_ingestion: daily county searches or link integration
notes: Useful for maintenance, facilities and public-works classifications.

name: CalOpps Job Search
coverage: Bay Area and California local agencies
what_it_contains: Local agency jobs including public works and utilities
recommended_ingestion: daily; canonicalize to agency listing when possible
notes: Good source for smaller cities and special districts.

name: Apprenticeship.gov Job Finder
what_it_contains: Apprenticeship openings and sponsor links
recommended_ingestion: weekly geo searches; deduplicate against DIR and union sources
notes: Useful for non-union and national sponsors as well as local listings.

name: BACWA Wastewater Career Links
what_it_contains: Links to member wastewater agency career pages
recommended_ingestion: monthly directory refresh; daily follow of priority agency boards
notes: Creative employer discovery source for utility trades.

name: San Francisco Building Permits Open Data
what_it_contains: Nightly building-permit data usable to identify active construction clusters
recommended_ingestion: daily via official API after selecting exact dataset/resource ID
notes: Discovery source only until the exact dataset ID and contractor-field quality are validated.

name: SFO Construction Opportunities
what_it_contains: Airport construction contracting and project opportunities
recommended_ingestion: weekly; connect projects to contractors after award
notes: Upstream demand signal; use award notices to grow employer graph.

name: Craigslist SF Bay Area Construction Jobs
what_it_contains: Small-contractor and short-cycle construction postings
recommended_ingestion: manual/link-out only until terms and spam controls are implemented
robots_or_terms_note: High terms/spam risk; do not scrape by default
notes: Creative long-tail source, but lower trust than unions and official boards.

name: Von public-safe demo resume profile
what_it_contains: Public-safe work history, training, certifications, skills and target role information
recommended_ingestion: Manual demo seed only; do not publish raw resume or contact fields
robots_or_terms_note: Not a web source; user-provided personal information
notes: Repository version must use first name Von only and exclude phone, email, LinkedIn, street address and legal name.
